packMeta.name: TutorTrack (SoftN + Forms)
packMeta.description: Turnkey tutoring studio and music lessons desk: filterable lesson schedule with one-click progress note logging, student and guardian dossiers, homework and copyable parent updates, tutor roster, and printable HTML tuition invoices. Includes the full-stack SoftN application plus 5 schema-matched FormLogic forms & management charts sharing the same live SQLite database.
